user.title: TP-Link account
user.description: Sign in with the account you use in the Tapo and/or Kasa app. Devices are controlled through TP-Link's cloud, so they keep working even when new firmware (TPAP) breaks local control.

mfa.title: Verification code required
mfa.description: TP-Link sent a verification code to {username} for the {cloud} cloud. Enter it below.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TP-Link cloud

abort.already_configured: This TP-Link account is already configured

data.local_probe: Probe local network for protocol status

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the TP-Link cloud for device state. Lower values give faster updates but more cloud traffic.
data_description.local_probe: Broadcasts TP-Link discovery packets each poll to detect whether devices are TPAP-locked or still locally controllable. Results appear as attributes on each device's Cloud connection sensor.
